name: Kurikuri Click ~Ore no Renaissance~
original_name: くりくりクリック ～オレのルネッサンス～
source:
Our protagonist lives in a remote forest and makes a living as a masseuse specializing in oil massages using a secret oil concoction. However, when the Empire suddenly started a war of aggression, customers stopped coming, and no longer able to have his way with women through his oil massages, the protagonist hungers for women.

Then, one day, he meets a female knight who escaped after being injured and defeated in battle against enemy forces. Not only is the protagonist taken aback by the sudden appearance of a visitor, he is practically salivating at her looks. Under the guise of an oil massage to supposedly heal her wounds, he lays on the fragrant oil and begins his work…

Yes… This will be my Renaissance!

[Edited from [url=https://denpasoft.com/product/kuri-kuri-click-2-my-renaissance/]Denpasoft[/url]]
translation:
主角独居在偏远的森林里，靠秘方调制的按摩油做油压按摩为生。帝国突然发动侵略战争以后，客人便不再上门。他也没办法像过去那样借按摩之便在女人身上占便宜，越发欲求不满。

一天，一名女骑士在迎战敌军时落败负伤，逃到了他这里。突然有客来访已经够意外了，女骑士的美貌更让他几乎流下口水。他借口说油压按摩能疗伤，涂上芬芳的按摩油，动起手来…

没错…这就是我的文艺复兴！
